title: reorganize-tfstate-per-vpc-and-gpu-ip-allocation
author: Ava Kline
description: Rework Terraform modules to support per-VPC tfstate separation and explicit GPU node IP allocation for Private deployments. Motivation: large customers running multiple isolated VPCs were hitting locking and scaling limits with a single shared state file and encountering IP exhaustion/conflicts for GPU node pools on crowded on-prem networks. This PR introduces a new tfstate layout (state per-vpc and per-environment), an optional subnet-aware IP allocator for gpu_subpool module, IAM role refinements for kms/hsm usage in private installs, and a state-migrator helper to ease customer upgrades. The description below summarizes the changes, migration steps, tests performed, and known limitations.
commits: init: split state backend config into vpc-scoped modules
feat(gpu): add subnet_aware_ip_allocation and mtu_override to gpu_subpool module
chore: bump module versions and update README with migration notes
feat(iam): add dedicated role for kms-hsm-access with least-privilege policy
tools: add state-migrator script and smoke migration plan for operators
test: add tf plan checks and integration scenario for dual-vpc private installs

release_notes:
- New: Per-VPC tfstate layout to isolate state and reduce lock contention for large private deployments.
- New: subnet_aware_ip_allocation for gpu_subpool to avoid IP conflicts in on-prem networks.
- New: state-migrator helper script and documented migration plan for operators.
- Change: IAM role for KMS/HSM access now uses a dedicated least-privilege role.
- Note: Plan-time validations added for allocator CIDR range conflicts. Operators should read the upgrade guide before applying to production.
notes_for_ops: Migration steps summarized: 1) Run scripts/state-migrator/migrate.sh --dry-run against staging. 2) Snapshot existing backend state and lock. 3) Run real migrate with --confirm and monitor the state lock table. 4) Apply updated gpu_subpool with subnet_aware_ip_allocation=false initially, validate node provisioning, then enable allocator. See examples/private/upgrade-migration-plan.md for full commands.
known_limitations: - The allocator assumes non-overlapping L2 segments; customers with dynamic on-prem IPAM systems must provide exclusion ranges. - HSM-backed KMS integration is gated behind on-prem feature flags and requires manual CA updates in some environments. - Rollback is best-effort if third-party state backends have inconsistent object versions.
testing_summary: Validated on two staging VPCs (aws-like and gcp-like) with both single shared state and per-vpc state. GPU node pools tested with and without subnet_aware_ip_allocation. Performed KMS decrypt integration smoke test using a short-lived key. Load-tested state migration tool with 10k resources in a simulated cluster to verify lock contention reductions.
customer_impact: Low for most customers but medium for tenants who use a shared state file. We coordinated planned maintenance windows with pilot customers. Operators on older releases must follow the migration guide; automatic migration is provided but operator supervision is recommended.
follow_up_tasks: - Address tf lint informational notes (small naming cleanup). - Add automated e2e that runs state-migrator against sample backends in CI. - Document HSM-specific CA rotation steps in private-installer docs.
